title: V1 Acceptance LOW — DomainEventCollector isolation regression
description: Stage C Test 1 legitimate bounded regression/safety improvement. Add focused regression coverage proving DomainEventCollector instances remain isolated and that mutating a previously pulled batch cannot reintroduce or contaminate later recorded events. No production runtime code changes are permitted.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage C Test 1 must remain deterministically LOW. It requires exact-artifact ACTIVE LOCK plus provider-bound Verification and protected merge/post-merge evidence. If effective risk escalates, Test 1 fails closed and a different legitimate LOW task must be selected.

acceptance_criteria.description: Two independent DomainEventCollector instances never leak recorded events across instance boundaries.
Mutating the array returned by pullEvents after a drain cannot reintroduce or contaminate events subsequently recorded by the collector.
The task changes only the three authorized paths and contains no production runtime, workflow, dependency, database, API or canonical roadmap mutation.
Deterministic classification remains LOW with Human Gate not required; classification is not forced or downgraded.
Exact-head verify, Phase A and merge-policy checks pass before protected merge.
Success is claimed only after protected Merge Policy workflow merge and exact-SHA post-merge PASS on the resulting canonical main SHA.
